generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: stems to 3 m tall or more, 20 to 40 cm across, armoured with old leaf bases and cataphylls; leaves 0.9 to 1.4 m long, the petiole 3 to 13 cm; leaflets in 80 to 130 pairs, 6 to 12 cm long, at 90 degrees. Drawn as a trunk 0.15 m in radius, rising 0.04 m a year; fronds 1.15 m long, the petiole 0.07 of them, 104 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.08 of the frond; 8 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 12 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Female cone on a peduncle 4 to 5 cm, buried in the cataphylls; male cone on one 3 to 3.5 cm, so it looks sessile.

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: stems to 3 m tall or more, 20 to 40 cm across, armoured with old leaf bases and cataphylls; leaves 0.9 to 1.4 m long, the petiole 3 to 13 cm; leaflets in 80 to 130 pairs, 6 to 12 cm long, at 90 degrees. The whole plant's height at 60 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 3.3 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them (the scientific name where no common name is in wide use), and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a cycad's crown of pinnate leaves on a pachycaul stem, drawn on the palm program.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: four seeds, so male and female plants both show.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: female cone ovoid, 25 to 29 cm long, erect, then leaning.

traits.cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: female cone 19 to 24 cm across.

traits.cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: the megasporophyll's face triangular, 9.8 to 11 cm high by 4.5 to 5.5 cm wide, pointed and woolly.

traits.cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: female cone ovoid.

traits.cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: female cone densely felted, the lowest one or two rows glabrous; the colour by eye.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: male cone cylindrical, 17.5 to 20 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: male cone 6 to 7.5 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163), Dioon edule: the microsporophyll's face triangular, 1.2 to 1.5 cm wide by 1 cm high, its tip pointed.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: male cone cylindrical.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: male cone densely white or brownish-grey felted; the colour by eye.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: sclerotesta ovoid to globose, 2.4 to 3 cm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: sclerotesta 1.9 to 2.2 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: sarcotesta yellow when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 163-164), Dioon edule: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
